The '''2026–27 Primera División de El Salvador''', also known as the '''Liga Ganaplay''', will be the 28th season and 54th and 55th Primera División tournament, El Salvador's top football division, since its establishment of an Apertura and Clausura format. [[C.D. Luis Angel Firpo|LA Firpo]]  and [[C.D. FAS|FAS]] are the defending champions of the Apertura and Clausura tournament respectively.
The league will consist of 12 teams. There will be two seasons conducted under identical rules, with each team playing a home and away game against the other clubs for a total of 22 games per tournament. At the end of each half-season tournament, the top six teams in that tournament's regular season standings will take part in the playoffs.

The champions of Apertura and Clausura will qualify for the [[CONCACAF Central American Cup]], the third team to qualify is the team with better aggregate record. Should the same team win both tournaments, both runners-up will qualify for [[CONCACAF Central American Cup]]. Should the final of both tournaments features the same two teams, the semi-finalist with the better aggregate record will qualify for [[CONCACAF Central American Cup]].

== Teams ==

=== Promotion and relegation ===

A total of 12 teams will contest the league, including 11 sides from the [[2025–26 Primera División de El Salvador|2025–26 Primera División]] and 1 promoted from the [[2025–26 Segunda División de Fútbol Salvadoreño|2025–26 Segunda División]].

[[Zacatecoluca F.C.]] was relegated to the [[Segunda División de Fútbol Salvadoreño|Segunda División]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/zacatecoluca-desciende-20260425-0009.html|title=Zacatecoluca FC es bicampeón y asciende a Primera División|trans-title=Zacatecoluca desciende a segunda|language=es|date=25 April 2026|access-date=2 May 2026|website=el grafico.com}}</ref>

On May 31, 2026 [[C.D. INCA-Aruba|INCA-Aruba]] the Clausura 2026 champion defeated the Apertura 2025 Champion [[Atletico Balboa]] 4-2 on penalties after the match ended after extra time.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/inca-derrota-a-balboa-en-penales-y-sube-a-primera-division-20260531-0017.html|title=INCA Aruba derrota a Balboa en penales y sube a Primera División|trans-title=Inca Aruba defeated Balboa via penalties and promoted to Primera Division|language=es|date=31 May 2026|access-date=1 June 2026|website=elgrafico.com}}</ref>

== Notable events ==
===Conclusion of Multi-Club Ownership ===
As a result of new [[multi-club ownership]] laws, on 8 May 2026 FESFUT announced they would take ownership of [[C.D. Hércules|Hércules]] and [[C.D. Aguila|Aguila]] from World Talent Group and take charge of finding new owners.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Valiente |first1=Josué |title=FESFUT tomará control de Hércules y Águila para futura venta |url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/fesfut-tomara-control-de-hercules-y-aguila-para-futura-venta-20260507-0009.html |website=elgrafico |access-date=2 October 2026 |language=es |date=7 May 2026 |trans-title=FESFUT will take control of Hércules and Águila for future sale}}</ref>

===Inter FA rebranded to Internacional Santa Tecla  ===
On 27 May 2026, Inter FA announced they would be rebranded as [[Inter Santa Tecla|Internacional Santa Tecla]], and change team colours to green and black to be more inline with the city's previous club [[Santa Tecla F.C.|Santa Tecla FC]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Adiós, Inter FA: ahora es Internacional Santa Tecla |url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/adios-inter-fa-ahora-es-internacional-santa-tecla-20260527-0021.html |access-date=May 29, 2026 |website=el Grafico.com|language=es}}</ref>

===Atletico Balboa purchase Hercules spot===
On 18 June 2026, [[Atletico Balboa]] announced they had made a mutual agreement to purchase [[C.D. Hércules|Hércules]]' spot in the Primera Division, conditional on FESFUT's approval.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Atlético Balboa y Hércules llegan a acuerdo para adquirir categoría en Primera |url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/atletico-balboa-y-hercules-llegan-a-acuerdo-para-adquirir-categoria-en-primera-20260618-0022.html |access-date=June 19, 2026 |website=el Grafico.com|language=es}}</ref> On July 6, FESFUT approved the purchase of [[Atletico Balboa]] from [[C.D. Hércules|Hércules]], conditional on Balboa meeting the league pre-requisites.<ref>{{Cite web |title=FESFUT autoriza al Atlético Balboa a cerrar la compra de la categoría del Hércules |url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/fesfut-autoriza-al-atletico-balboa-a-cerrar-la-compra-de-la-categoria-del-hercules-20260706-0022.html |access-date=July 6, 2026 |website=el Grafico.com|language=es}}</ref>

===Introduction of VAR===
On 24 July 2026, it was announced that [[video assistant referee]] (referred to as 'Football Video Support' or 'FVS') would be implemented for the upcoming season.<ref>{{Cite web |title=El fútbol salvadoreño estrenó el FVS y validó el primer gol tras revisión de video |url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/el-futbol-salvadoreno-estreno-el-fvs-y-valido-el-primer-gol-tras-revision-de-video-20260724-0018.html |access-date=July 25, 2026 |website=el Grafico.com|language=es}}</ref>

===Foreign player increase===
On 24 July 2026, FESFUT approved teams to have 5 foreign players in their squad, limited to four on a matchday.<ref>{{Cite web |title=FESFUT aprueba inscripción de un quinto extranjero para el Apertura 2026 |url=https://www.elgrafico.com/primera/fesfut-aprueba-inscripcion-de-un-quinto-extranjero-para-el-apertura-2026-20260724-0004.html |access-date=July 25, 2026 |website=el Grafico.com|language=es}}</ref>
